events.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what still needs to be done?
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara — we still need a few volunteers to sort donated materials, a couple people to manage sign-ins, and someone to keep the supply list updated.
events.speaker: Rosa

events.text: Mara: I can take the supply list and help sort materials too. If you want, I can also cover a sign-in shift.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Sam: Happy to help with the repair drive, Mara. What do you need me to bring or do?
events.speaker: Sam

events.text: Mara: Thanks, Sam — could you bring a drill, a tape measure, and a few screwdrivers? If you can, please help sort the donated tools when you arrive.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll bring a drill, a tape measure, and some screwdrivers, and I’ll help sort the donated tools when I get there.
events.speaker: Sam

events.text: Leo: Yep — I’m ready to help check who needs what.
events.speaker: Leo

events.text: Mara: Great — could you help check who needs what and let me know if sign-ins or sorting still need coverage?
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll check sign-ins and sorting now, and tell you what still needs coverage.
events.speaker: Leo

events.text: Mara: I can take the supply list and help sort materials, and I can cover a sign-in shift too if that still helps.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Eli: That helps a lot, Mara—please take the supply list and sort the materials, and if you can, cover a sign-in shift too. Let’s keep it organized and decide the meeting spot next.

events.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll take the supply list, sort the materials, and cover the sign-in shift. Where should we meet?
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Mara: Thanks, Leo — can you tell me what still needs coverage? I’ll jump in where it’s open.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Leo: I’ll check the sign-ins and sorting, and let you know what’s still open.
events.speaker: Leo

events.text: Mara: Great, thanks, Leo — I’ll be here and ready to fill any open spots once you’ve checked sign-ins and sorting.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Jules: I can reach out to whoever hasn’t heard yet—who should I make sure to tell?
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Mara: Please make sure Sam and Leo hear—we still need help with tool sorting and checking sign-ins. If anyone else can pitch in, I can place them where we’re short.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll make sure Sam and Leo know, and I’ll ask around for anyone else who can help with sorting and sign-ins.
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Mara: I can help with the sign-in shift and keep the supply list updated—just let me know which spots are still open.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Mina: Thanks, Mara — sign-in is covered, so we still need a few people for the repair tables and cleanup. I’ll send you the open spots now.

events.text: Mara: Got it — I can take a repair table and help with cleanup too. Send over the open spots when you can.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara — the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center. If you can take the supply list and help sort materials, that would be a big help.
events.speaker: Rosa
